content.comment_body: Hello, Is there a straightforward way to set the time and date on a [product_name] without having to navigate deep into the settings? With timer settings on the display, pressing the escape button for several seconds allows changes. However, this method doesn't work for setting time and date, and when the [product_name] is in OP mode, you can't adjust them at all. My aim is to make it simple for users to set or change the time and date, avoiding complex menu navigation that could disrupt machine operation.

No, changing the time and date programmatically from the [product_name]-program via the display and buttons isn't supported; only menu settings allow access to the clock. You can set the clock using: the [product_name] menu, the associated configuration software, an HMI connected in the same network, or an app provided for [product_name].
Additionally, the [product_name] can automatically get the time from a communication module via GPRS with an NTP Server, or through GPS.

Thanks for your insights, everyone. This could be a good suggestion for a future software update or a new generation of the [product_name]. At times, programming the [product_name] can be frustrating—I remember working with competitor controllers and finding useful function blocks missing in the [product_name]. For instance, features like 'cam block,' 'pump sequence block,' or 'boolean block,' and writing text over a parameter window in the display, were available there. Being able to connect a temperature sensor directly to an input was also handy and cost-effective, even if it wasn’t as accurate. Perhaps I'm just used to more flexibility.

analysis.insight_summary: Users find setting the time and date on [product_name] unnecessarily difficult, lacking a direct and intuitive method for quick adjustments. The current approach involves navigating complex menus or using external devices/software, which is seen as inconvenient and potentially disruptive. Users are also dissatisfied with the lack of advanced features compared to similar controllers from other brands.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a simple and safe way for end-customers to set or adjust the time and date directly on [product_name] using the display or front-panel buttons, without accessing complex menus or risking unintended changes to other settings.
